item.title: Hiking in the snowy Ciucaș Mountains
item.description: Winter is my favourite season 🙂 And hiking in the mountains is one of my favourite activities! So a combination of these two is pretty close to perfection. In order to reach perfection, the weather has to be good and favor the best views! And that’s exactly how it was last weekend when I went on a trip to the Ciucaș mountains. Last time I was there, about a year ago, there was very little snow, unusually little for that time of year and the weather was foggy, so I barely saw anything around me for the best part of the hike.

item.title: Hiking in the Ciucaș Mountains
item.description:
There’s nothing like a day in the mountains! 😀

The weather was not that great (lots of fog and wind) and also there should have been waaay more snow this time of year, but we still had a great time on our eight hour hike in the Ciucaș mountains. The scenery was amazing!
